name: Machine Learning Systems Engineer
description: Build ML inference engines, model servers, and training pipelines. Optimize tensor operations and manage model lifecycles.
example_snippet:
program TensorOps:
    shape Tensor holds:
        Data as raw handle to fractional number
        Rows as whole number
        Cols as whole number

        method get takes R as whole number, C as whole number produces fractional number:
            produce success with Index at the sum of the product of R and Cols and C of Data
        end method

        method set takes R as whole number, C as whole number, V as fractional number produces nothing:
            put V into Index at the sum of the product of R and Cols and C of Data
        end method
    end shape

    keep T as unique handle to Tensor with new Tensor with nothing and 3 and 3
    call T.set with 1 and 1 and 5.0

    keep Val as fractional number
    call T.get with 1 and 1 giving Val
    print the text "T[1][1] = " and Val and newline
end program
